svg.title: encryptedFetch: one request and response
svg.desc: The server checks the signature, unwraps keys, verifies the MAC, decrypts and checks time before consuming the request ID. Business code runs only after those checks. The client binds the response to its request and HTTP status before authentication and decryption. Business HTTP errors remain the caller’s responsibility; network or authentication failures do not replay the operation.
svg.metadata:
flowchart TB A["Client: obtain a usable session; read a bounded body"] B["Client: encrypt, MAC and sign; bind ID, time, method and path"] C["Server: verify binding
Check signature, unwrap keys
Verify MAC, then decrypt"] D["Server: check time and consume ID
Recheck time after consumption"] E["Run business handler; encrypt and authenticate the response"] F["Client: bind request and status; verify signature / MAC and decrypt"] G["Return the restored Response"] X["Reject the message; do not replay business work"] A --> B B --> C C --> D D --> E E --> F F --> G C -->|"authentication fails"| X D -->|"expired / duplicate / store failure"| X F -->|"binding / authentication fails"| X classDef default fill:#edf3ff,stroke:#476aab,color:#172b4d,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef good fill:#e9f6ef,stroke:#28734e,color:#17452f,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef stop fill:#fff0f0,stroke:#af4040,color:#742b2b,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef pending fill:#fff6df,stroke:#a07827,color:#654b18,stroke-width:1.5px; class G good; class X stop;
